findings.summary: At session end the text points two ways. testing.md:28 says "A commit that changes only Joycraft records needs no test run". implement:116-118 says "No push without a green gate receipt". session-end:16 does records/tidy/archive commits, then one push. The probe shows that a records commit after the last green gate makes delivery.mjs push refuse (gate-receipt-stale). So the coordinator must either run the gate again on the record commits, or push with plain git and skip the receipt. Assumption: run the gate again before session end's push. Spec 25 or a later text spec should say this.

"open one PR when no spec can start" (unchanged) and session-end:16 "one push that opens the PR" both open the PR. If implement opens it first, session end's push is a second CI run: that is the pr-first option, which decision session-end-push-order rejected. "Read CI once, on the PR, after session end's push" limits the reading but not the runs. Assumption: session end is the point where no spec can start, so both name the same PR open.

"push after each accepted spec" -> "push after each green gate": the brief does not say this. It follows from brief wave-gate ("delivery.mjs refuses a push without a green gate receipt"): in wave mode an accepted spec has no receipt at HEAD, so the old rule could not run. The brief has no rule for pushes in the middle of a queue; decision session-end-push-order covers only session end. In this repo the change does not add PR CI runs, because test.yml runs on PRs and workflow_call. This project's AGENTS.md:18 still says "Push after each accepted spec", and that line wins. With gateRuns: wave, that rule cannot run, because delivery refuses the push. Spec 16 (owner gate lines) or the owner should look at it.

evidence.mjs accepts only a receipt path that is git-ignored or inside a feature folder under docs/features/. Any other path is refused ("Receipt must be git-ignored or inside a feature folder"). The "or commit pending files first" branch therefore works only with a feature-folder path. The refusal is loud, but delivery.md could name both allowed places.

When tests.gate is not recorded, delivery.mjs ignores --gate-receipt and needs "-- <verifier>". The implement text says only "No push without a green gate receipt" and does not name this fallback. delivery.mjs usage text covers it.

The four cut sentences lose no rule. (1) "Missing context permits explicit assumptions ... does not require an architecture document" survives in entry SKILL.md:46, implement:19 ("a local repair needs no architecture review") and architecture.md:36. Its nuance "progress on understood scope" is now only implied by "when available" and "reporting unresolved coverage". (2) "Keep unfinished independent work visible" survives in session-end:19 and implement:99. (3) "Do not defer ordinary checks to the batch boundary" is carried by "run checks ... as you go". (4) "Worktree separation does not establish a separate reviewer context" survives in dispatch.md:114 and worktrees.md:30, which verify links in the same sentence. Assumption: the remaining nuance in (1) is enough.

The comment says the BEFORE counts come "at the commit before it (9dbe887)", but the parent of 21591ac is c144c92. The counts match at c144c92 (1333/1374/1185), so the test is right and only the comment is wrong. The installed() git fixture in AC-1 and AC-5 copies a file into a repo and reads the same bytes back, which adds nothing over reading payload/. It meets the spec's "use git fixtures" line only in form.

delivery.md grows by 262 words and says "joycraft-implement follows this section on every push". With gateRuns: spec that means every spec, but EVERY_SPEC_FILES lists it as on-demand. This is within the guard as written. Spec 26 or the guard owner should decide whether it now counts as every-spec reading.
